scenario.description: Ctrl P and comments on any line (PLAN §18.1, §8; DESIGN §4.1 "File finder", "File view"): the file finder lists every file of the review's new side (`file_finder`: the changed one first, then by path), filters as the file list does (a name match before a directory match) and opens an unchanged file in the file view; a line of it takes a comment (`C`), placed in that file though the review doesn't change it (`session.threads[].in_diff` false), its card inline in the file view; back in the stream it heads the "Not in the diff" section as on a file the review doesn't change, with View file, which opens the file view at its line; `dv comment list --json` says it is placed and `in_diff: false`; the agent then edits the file: it joins the review and the thread follows its code there, moved. Screenshots of the finder, the file view with the card and the section in dark Mica.
